applicabilityBasis.summary: ONED is marketed as a USD-referenced settlement token, but the governing Coinbase Custom Stablecoin terms give holders ownership of underlying USDC and redemption into that crypto-asset, not an established issuer obligation to repay a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value. Payment use is evidenced; GENIUS classification therefore remains genuinely ambiguous.

GENIUS Act section 2: monetary value excludes digital assets

genius.notes: Reviewed October 7 2026. Coinbase identifies ONED as a Custom Stablecoin backed 1:1 by USDC and excludes EEA users from its custom-token buy/sell/conversion service. ONED holder terms expressly incorporate Coinbase's U.S. User Agreement. Appendix 4 section 13 gives transferable ownership of custodial USDC and 1:1 redemption into USDC for eligible Coinbase account holders; it does not guarantee the reserve asset's value or fiat repayment. The agreement names Coinbase, Inc. as counterparty but allows Custom Stablecoins to be issued by Coinbase or affiliates; no exact ONED issuing affiliate was established, so issuerEntity and domicile are not guessed. Gennius platform payment marketing does not establish a monetary-value repayment obligation or GENIUS permission. Live itemized Coinbase reserves are an issuer display, not a monthly independent attestation. No downstream token permission is inherited from USDC or Coinbase licensing. General GENIUS DASP restrictions are not yet active; existing sanctions and service eligibility remain separate.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified issuer authorization, official GENIUS application or foreign registration was located for ONED and any Coinbase/Gennius ONED issuer in the stated materials and exact-token searches. This is a bounded public-source review, not proof of legal non-compliance or an assertion that no nonpublic application exists. The SCRC IFR is procedural and legacy trust/MTL permissions are not GENIUS issuer qualification. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was located; platform or affiliate regulatory history is not treated as token enforcement. The exact legal token issuer remains unresolved, limiting entity-level completeness; the negative conclusion covers the stated token names and opened public materials only.
